recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas to an arbitrary address.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) forwards all gas and arbitrary calldata.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) sends ETH out of the CryptoPunks market.

to.transfer(balance) sweeps the entire contract balance.
balanceOf[...]-- and punksRemainingToAssign-- without SafeMath (Solidity 0.6.8).
balanceOf[seller]-- / balanceOf[msg.sender]++ with no overflow protection.
numControllers-- can underflow when the counter is already zero.
fee = fees[1] + numTokens * fees[2] and fee += addedFee performed without SafeMath.
now.add(getDelay(lockId)) makes unlock timing miner-influenceable (timestamp dependency).
keccak256(now, msg.sender, randNonce) % modulus is predictable and miner-influenceable.
getCPM().buyPunk(tokenId) external call before the vault updates its own accounting.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only consumed by the setInitialOwner assignment logic.
The punk index parameter is only used to index the ownership mapping inside setInitialOwner.
The addresses array is only iterated by setInitialOwners.
The indices array is only iterated by setInitialOwners.
The recipient parameter exists solely to feed the sendValue low-level call.
The amount parameter exists solely to feed the sendValue low-level call.
The target parameter is only used as the destination of the low-level call.
The data parameter is only used as calldata for the low-level call.
The new address parameter is consumed when the owner rewires the vault/ERC20 references.
numTokens only participates in the fee computation in getFee.
The lock id only selects a release-time slot inside initiateUnlock.
The modulus only participates in the getPseudoRand modulo operation.
The new fee array only replaces the mint schedule in setMintFees.
The account parameter only drives the integrator whitelist update.
The token id parameter is only processed by the mintPunk entry point.
The token id array is only processed by the batch mint entry point.
The redeem count is only processed by the batch redeem entry point.
The destination address only drives the owner-only migration transfer.
The extcodesize result feeds the contract check guarding the low-level call helper.
The success flag is the return value of the low-level call operation.
The returned bytes come from the low-level call operation.
The amount local is the value passed to the ETH transfer operation.
The seller local is a temporary used only inside buyPunk.
The bid storage pointer is only used inside buyPunk.
The offer storage pointer is only used inside buyPunk.
The existing bid pointer is only used inside enterBidForPunk.
The token id local is only used inside simpleRedeem.
The release time local is only produced by initiateUnlock.
The fee local is only produced and returned by getFee.
The addedFee local is the unchecked accumulation inside getFee.
The random index local is only used to index reserves in _redeemPunk.
The cached sender local is only used for the owner checks in _mintPunk.
The token amount local is only used to burn within _redeemPunk.
The minted counter local is only maintained inside _mintPunkMultiple.
The new token id array local is only built inside _mintPunkMultiple.
The balance local is only read to feed the owner sweep transfer.
